auth.signInHint: Use your passkey, or sign in with your email address and password.
auth.signInFailed: Could not sign in. Please try again.
auth.passkeyUnavailable: No passkey was used. Sign in with your password instead.
auth.passkeyUnsupported: This browser does not support passkeys. Sign in with your password instead.

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: Your name and email address. The name is shown in the sidebar and in your browser's passkey prompt.
profile.emailInvalid: That is not a valid email address.
profile.emailTaken: Another account already uses that email address.
profile.nameTooLong: A name may be at most 150 characters.

avatar.title: Picture
avatar.help: JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF or AVIF, at most {megabytes} MB and {megapixels} megapixels. It is cropped to a {size}×{size} square.
avatar.tooLarge: That file is larger than {megabytes} MB. Choose a smaller picture.
avatar.rejected: That picture could not be used. It must be a JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF or AVIF of at most {megapixels} megapixels — crop a panorama or a high-resolution shot first.

password.title: Password
password.description: Changing your password signs you out everywhere else. You stay signed in here.
password.changed: Password changed. Other devices were signed out.
password.mismatch: The two new passwords do not match.
password.tooShort: A password must be at least {min} characters.
password.wrongCurrent: That is not your current password.
password.noCredential: This account has no password yet. Ask an administrator to set one.
password.none: This account signs in with passkeys only.

passkeys.title: Passkeys
passkeys.description: Sign in with your fingerprint, face or device PIN instead of a password.
passkeys.addFailed: The passkey was not added. Please try again.
passkeys.unsupported: This browser does not support passkeys.
passkeys.removeDescription: The device it lives on can no longer sign in to Yana. You can add it again later.
passkeys.removeFailed: The passkey could not be removed.
passkeys.lastOneNeedsPassword: This is your only way to sign in. Set a password before removing it.

library.title: Library
library.retentionHelp: Articles older than this are removed. Starred articles are kept.
library.intervalHelp: How often feeds are checked for new articles.
library.retentionRange: Article retention must be between 1 and 3650 days.
library.intervalRange: Update interval must be between 1 and 1440 minutes.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.description: This part of the page could not be loaded. The details were written to the server log.
error.fatalDescription: The application failed before it could render. Check the server log, then reload.
